background.description: Wide view of the apartment entrance, with the open door behind Ailan and Max inside facing him. Roko is visible behind Max, staring at the unexpected human.

characters.action: Enters through the open door in a convincing new human appearance and waves to his roommates.
Sitting on the couch, turns toward the unfamiliar human in the doorway and recoils slightly.
characters.dialogue: A human? What are you doing here?

characters.action: Sitting on couch. Stares silently at Ailan, brow furrowed and eyes narrowed, his facial expression clearly asking, 'What is a human doing in here?'

background.description: Medium view just inside the apartment entrance, continuing the doorway conversation with Ailan and Max in front and Roko clearly visible behind Max.

characters.action: Gestures proudly at his new human appearance, presenting himself for inspection. He rolls up one sleeve to show a robot arm but otherwise looks fully human
characters.dialogue: No, it's me, Ailan! Check out my new look!

characters.action: Standing up to inspect Ailan, relaxing as recognition dawns.
characters.dialogue: Well clip my papers! You sure fooled me!

characters.action: Keeps watching Ailan silently from behind Max, brow still furrowed and eyes narrowed. Even as Max relaxes, Roko's facial expression continues to ask, 'What is a human doing in here?'

background.description: Wide view of the apartment couch area. Ailan stands on the left performing for his roommates; Roko is beside the couch on the right, suddenly scrutinizing him. Leave room for Ailan's longer speech followed by Roko's reply, reading left to right.

characters.action: Adopts an exaggerated video-host pose, smiling broadly at an imaginary camera and delivering his practiced greeting.
characters.dialogue: I've been practicing my human speak! "Welcome to my YouTube channel! Be sure to like and subscribe!"

characters.action: Suddenly stops what he is doing, narrows his gaze at Ailan's human appearance, and raises one questioning finger as though reassessing an old debt.
characters.dialogue: Wait a minute... did you contribute to my creation?
